main_text.p: rium. 2. Propinqua causa. Thes.IV. Scientia quaevis versatur circa generalia. ἐχ9.1. Vniuersalia à solo in-telectu percipiuntur. 2. Intelectus non percipit uniuersalia nisi per singularia in sensum incurrentia: quomodo omnia. quæ sunt in intellectu, ante fue-rint in sensu? 3. Franciscus Picus Mirandulanus Phyficam arguit incertitudinis, quod è sensu ortum habeat. 4. monstrosum Xeniadis argumentum: ibid. Refutatur sententia hæc. 5. occurritur argumento contrario. 6. Quo modo intellectus efficiat actu uniuersalia[?] 7. Qui in Physica scientia omnium fuere excellen-tissimi, ij vel nihil scripserunt, vel si scripseru nt,ad nos eorum scripta non pervenerunt. Duo præstan-tissimi ab orbe condito Physici, Adamus in statu innocentiæ, & Salomon in regni flore. 8. Probatur Adamum fuisse omnium rerum naturalium scientissi-mum. 9. Scientia rerum Physicarum quanta in Salomone? 10. libri ab eo scripti: ibid. Reges & Principes qui sumtus contulerunt ad scientiæ physicæ locu-pletationem. 11. Græcis magnam scientiæ physicæ partem debemus. 12. De Epicuro nonnihil: ibid. De Platone. 13. Laudes Aristotelis. 14. Vituperia Aristote-lis. 15. Hieroglyphicum ejus: incertitudo doctrinæ multis argumentis probata. ibid. Vnde tanta Aristotelis autoritas? ibid. Incertum an vllum habeamus Aristotelis librum. ibid. Æquius de Aristotele judicium, & media inter extremas sententia. 16. Nimij admiratores Aristotelis. Duo memorabilia circa mortem Aristotelis. 17. Veteres Physici & interpretes Aristotelis. 18. Laudes Scaligeri. 19. Laudes Gesneri, Aldrovandi, Mathioli, Agricolæ. 20. Materia Physica. Thes. V. Materia à subjecto distinguitur. Ἐχ9. Forma [illegible, ~8 letters]

page.notes: Greek word after "Forma" and the Greek mark "ἐχ9" are only partly legible; the Greek readings are doubtful. "uniuersalia[?]" at item 6: the printed mark after the word is unclear. Lines appear to run as one block with no clear paragraph indents, so the page is set as a single paragraph. Printing error kept: "scripseru nt". Long s is normalised to s throughout. The left edge of the neighbouring page (fragments such as "M", "Thef.1", "iq; vfus") is excluded.
